Lactate_previous.definition: Latest valid observation strictly before current hour; NaN if none within 24 hours. At a measurement hour this is the preceding measurement.

WBC_previous.definition: Latest valid observation strictly before current hour; NaN if none within 24 hours. At a measurement hour this is the preceding measurement.

HR_mean_3h.definition: Mean of actual valid measurements in (t-window,t]; at least one observation.

HR_mean_6h.definition: Mean of actual valid measurements in (t-window,t]; at least one observation.

HR_mean_12h.definition: Mean of actual valid measurements in (t-window,t]; at least one observation.

HR_mean_24h.definition: Mean of actual valid measurements in (t-window,t]; at least one observation.

HR_min_6h.definition: Min of actual valid observations in (t-6,t]; at least one observation.

HR_max_6h.definition: Max of actual valid observations in (t-6,t]; at least one observation.

HR_std_6h.definition: Sample standard deviation of actual valid observations in (t-6,t]; at least two observations.

HR_count_6h.definition: Count of actual valid observations in (t-6,t]; zero means no observations.

HR_delta_6h.definition: Bounded carried value at t minus bounded carried value available at exact hour t-6; both required. Vital carry limit 6h, lab limit 24h. No observation after t-6 enters the historical endpoint.

HR_trend_6h.definition: Least-squares slope per actual ICULOS hour using valid measurements in (t-6,t]; at least two observations at distinct hours.
